To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the fatigue damage of the bond between the prestressed steel strand and the concrete is a complex process.
the bond fatigue strength of prestressed concrete is related to the corrosion fatigue strength and fatigue stress.
the fatigue stress and corrosion factors have exponential decline, and the bond life of prestressed concrete structure is affected by the bond fatigue stress and corrosion.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the durability of prestressed concrete structure.
the fatigue damage law of bonded steel strand under corrosive environment, and the fatigue life prediction model is established.
the fatigue life of bonded steel strand under the condition of corrosion fatigue, which is of great significance to the safety and durability of prestressed concrete.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the corrosion of steel strand will lead to the reduction of bond strength, and the bond strength will decrease exponentially with the increase of corrosion fatigue strength factor.
the fatigue strength of the bond fatigue of the bond fatigue was significantly reduced by the corrosion fatigue strength factor, and it was reduced by 50% under the fatigue stress of 50MPa.
the fatigue damage of steel strand bond is mainly caused by the fatigue of steel strand, and the bond fatigue damage of the steel strand is mainly caused by fatigue damage of steel strands.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the fatigue damage law of bond between steel strand and reinforced concrete under corrosive chloride environment is established, the fatigue strength factor is obtained, and the prediction model for fatigue life is established.
the corrosion and fatigue of bonded steel strand in prestressed concrete structure can be effectively evaluated by the prediction model.
the bond fatigue damage of steel strand in concrete is affected by the fatigue stress amplitude and the corrosion fatigue strength factor.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the fatigue stress amplitude and the corrosion fatigue strength factor have a great influence on the life of bonded steel strands, and the fatigue stress amplitude has a greater effect on the bond strength.
the fatigue stress and the corrosion fatigue strength factor of the bond fatigue of the steel strand and concrete all show the exponential decline.

the fatigue life of the bond between the steel strand and the concrete under the combined effect of the corrosion and the fatigue is related to the fatigue stress amplitude, the fatigue strength coefficient and the corrosion fatigue strength factor.
